0.description: Fixed an issue where Mass Dispel would say it was able to be ranked up while only rank 1 was trainable.
Fixed an issue Life Tap would say it was able to be ranked up while only rank 1 was trainable.
Fixed an issue where Mage Armor was able to say it was able to be ranked up while rank 2 and 3 were not trainable.
Fixed an issue where Rockbiter Rank 5 would say it was able to be ranked up while Rank 6 was not trainable.
Fixed an issue where players would not have criminal intent if they were over level 20.

Reverted a change where the dungeon finder would stack up based on how many members were in the party that qued for random dungeons as it only applied to one player. Now the buff for queing for random dungeons will be rewarded to the party and give 10% damage, 10% healing and a 10% health increase.
Removed vendor behaviour from a slough of empty vendors.
Scroll of Fortune levelling quests can now be auto completed.
You can now talk to other class trainers as a Hero.
The Sturdy Quarterstaff from the Path to Ascenion 1 quest now requires level 5 instead of level 8.
The Honor Hold and Thrallmar Stones of Retreat are now in the Vanity spell book page.
The Honor Hold and Thrallmar Stones of Retreat no longer have question marks for icons.
You will now revive at full health when at or below level 20.
Titan's Scrolls no longer apply to players below level 10. Levelling to 10 will immedietally apply all active world buffs to you.
You will now receive on-screen notifications when your abilities are ready to be ranked up.
Removed ability unlock notifications to reduce UX spam.
Criminal Intent will now send you a notification, informing you that it was taught to you at level 20.
Criminal Intent is no longer taught at level one.
New players now start with all 1-20 flight paths known.
You will no longer be able to buy Temporal Contracts before level 55.
Incorporated the community-made LFG Auto Reque addon into the base client install. This addon will automatically reque you for LFG when an internal que reset is triggered.
The Hot Spot visual (cloud of smoke) no longer plays when entering a Hot Spot as a ghost.
The Dice of Destiny is now informative based on your current conditions. It will not ask you to enable Wildcard Mode if you already have it enabled.
Rerolling abilities now tells you that you are rerolling abilities instead of telling you that you are re-activating Wildcard Mode.
The Character Advancement quick-access buttons are now disabled by default.
The Ascension Survival guide now opens at level 15 instead of level 10 to reduce UX spam.
Learned abilities will continue to be added to your action bars past level 10.
Corrected an issue where characters would be created with a bow and ammo equipped instead of arrows.
Equipping a crossbow without arrows equipped will automatically equip the first arrows found in your inventory.
Equipping a bow without arrows equipped will automatically equip the first arrows found in your inventory.
Equipping a gun without ammo equipped will automatically equip the first ammo found in your inventory.
Added an option to Riko to teach players more about Newcomers.
Returning Players now share all mentor-related functionality with Newcomers.
The Returning Player tag now shared visibility rules with the Newcomer tag.
